# People (this project)

> Roles on THIS project, so Claude doesn't ask "who's X?" every time.
> One person per block.
>
> SHARED — everyone with repo access reads this, and they may be in it. Keep it
> professional and factual: role, what they own, how they like to work. No contact
> details, no personal emails or phone numbers, no opinions about them, nothing you
> wouldn't say in front of them. Private notes go in the author's global memory.

<!-- Example shape:
## Ana — product owner
Owns: scope and final sign-off (not the dev team).
Works best with: weekly demo on Fridays, updates without jargon.
